desert_road.action: Complete elimination of residual vehicle marks, floating balloons, and shadow projections
desert_road.root_cause_resolved: YOLOv8n-seg missed the multicolored balloons floating 50-80px above the blue Mini Cooper roof; balloon pixels were projected by cameras 0 and 1 onto the road center. In V2.1, dilated dynamic masks enclose vehicle + balloons, 8 atlas tiles are inpainted, and fronto-parallel vertex coloring rejects all masked pixels.

campus_0049.action: Separate geometry vs texture audit with 4 diagnostic close-up contact sheets; retained manual-review baseline mesh and 4096x4096 texture atlas

distortion_attribution.mesh_geometry: Underlying geometry (128,336 vertices, 253,487 triangles) retained from manual-review baseline. Building facades are naturally smoothed by Poisson meshing due to hovering nadir drone telemetry (< 0.10m translation baseline); vertical walls are observed only obliquely.
distortion_attribution.photographic_textures: 4096x4096 texture atlas resolves crisp ground lettering ('FIRE LANE', 'STOP'), courtyard pavers, crosswalks, and roof parapet boundaries without geometric hallucinations.
